scope: Approved reusable local Character reference packs for Kie Wan 3.0
covered: Local pack create/update with post-hash revision compare-and-swap
Reversible archive and historical revision retention
Neutral identity anchor, valid image assets and selected-reference limits
Exact selected roles/order and original-byte validation before upload
Run recovery after editing/archiving a pack, with the same literal prompt and one mock task submission
Reject forged pack metadata and changed reference bytes before provider uploads
Native panel PNG equality, original-sheet preservation and crop provenance
Uniform resizing of small crops to the 240-pixel API minimum
Out-of-bounds, negative, undersized and overly wide crop rejection
Odd JPEG crops in decoded RGB space without subsampled-chroma displacement
Manual mode, historical selection, image numbering and complete prompt preview
Existing Kie task recovery, local editor and original GPU regression suite

browser.fixture: Separate local server and synthetic media; all external provider methods disabled
safariDesktop: Retain previous draft snapshot until explicit update

limitations: Reference roles are prompt guidance, not a trained multi-view identity embedding or expression rig
No paid sheet-versus-crop or expressions quality benchmark was run
No perfect identity, gaze, occlusion, lip-sync or latency guarantee
Characters and media remain local and do not travel with a Git pull
Image1 remains required as the scene-ready appearance reference
